layer_strategy.ruling: A chip can be a reviewed head-and-shoulder crop of the exact approved Qwen full-figure source, preserving identity, age and medium without a separate identity generation. Existing dedicated busts remain installed.
layer_strategy.cost: Avoid one Qwen Edit generation per future usable full source; no relaxation of native-size alpha and framing review.
layer_strategy.reviewer: main agent independently viewed dedicated / loose crop / tight crop black-white native96 and 2x comparison; tight frame approved as starting preset, adjusted per person where necessary.
layer_strategy.rebuild: install_map_art.py cast verifies Qwen source hash, rebuilds full layer first, then uses the exact approved full-alpha hash and crop to derive the chip with existing stdlib box filtering. No extra segmentation or identity generation.
